decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights to or from Orlando or Philadelphia between December 21 and December 27

actions.action: Rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks
Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: a 48-hour ground handling strike is planned at Orlando and Philadelphia on Dec 22-23, and flights on those days may be late or canceled. If you can travel on another day, move your flight now for free in the app: Dec 21 and Dec 24 still have seats. If you keep your flight and it is canceled, we will rebook you on Kestrel or a partner airline, or refund you in full if you prefer. All our aircraft are back in service after the engine inspections.
decisions.why:
Own seats in week 8 are 97% booked, so moving people early and a partner airline are the cheapest protection.
We skip the backup contract and keep $2.55M in reserve for surprises.
An honest early warning is what passengers remember.

decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights at Orlando or Philadelphia on December 22-23

actions.action: Hotel rooms held for stranded passengers, whatever the cause
Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks
Backup ground handling contract at both bases for the strike days

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: the ground handling strike at Orlando and Philadelphia is on December 22-23. We have contracted backup ground crews at both airports and added airport and call-center staff for the next two weeks. If your flight is canceled or delayed over 3 hours, we will rebook you on Kestrel or a partner airline, or refund you in full. If you are stranded overnight for any reason, a hotel room is held for you at no cost; show your boarding pass at the Kestrel desk.
decisions.why:
Families and vacationers are 88% of week-8 passengers; being stranded without a bed is what they remember.
Backup crews are the only insurance if the union extends the strike.
Staff on the phones keeps the 24-hour rebooking promise real.
